Cookies & Storage.

The small amount of browser storage that supports the contact form and quiz.

Last updated 30 October 2026

In this noticeOverviewContact sessionQuiz storageOther servicesYour controls

Language preference

The language switcher remembers an explicit choice as hotwire-language in first-party local storage. It contains only a supported language code and remains until you choose another language or clear site data. Browser-language detection alone does not save a preference. Translated URLs and the switcher still work when storage is blocked.

Website translations are served from local files. Contact messages, personal details, and draft-agreement fields are not sent to a translation service.

Overview

A cookie is a small value stored by your browser and sent with matching requests. Session storage is a separate browser feature used for information within a tab’s session.

The current website code does not include advertising or analytics cookies. It uses an essential contact-session cookie and optional-to-use quiz transfer storage described below. We do not display a marketing-cookie banner for tools that are not installed. If optional tracking is introduced, the notices and any required preference controls will need to be updated before it is enabled.

Contact session

Name
hotwire_contact
Type & scope
First-party PHP session cookie, scoped to /api/.
Purpose
Links your browser to security tokens and recent submission receipts, helping protect against forged requests and duplicate sends.
When it is used
When the contact service is opened, or when you choose Send inquiry and the page requests a security token.
Duration
A session cookie. Browser session-restoration settings may affect when it is removed; server-side session expiry depends on the host.
Contents
A session identifier, not your name, email address, or message. It is marked HttpOnly and SameSite=Strict; Secure is set when PHP receives an HTTPS request.

Recent submission receipts are used for up to one hour. Blocking this cookie prevents secure form submission, but you can still email the studio directly.

Quiz storage

Name
hotwire-website-brief
Type
First-party session storage in the tab where you take the quiz.
Purpose
Carries the ten selected answers, an optional design ID, and a timestamp to the contact page, only after you choose “Discuss this website”.
Duration
The contact page removes the entry when it reads it and rejects transfers older than ten minutes. An unread entry may remain until the browser ends the tab’s session or you clear it.
Contents
Quiz choices, optional design ID, and a timestamp only. Contact details and message text are not written to browser storage by the site.

Completing the quiz does not by itself send your answers to the server. If session storage is unavailable, you can still get your result and copy a description instead of carrying a brief across pages.

Design-selection links can carry a fixed design ID in the URL. Demo basket/booking selections and agreement-review fields use page memory only, not application cookies or browser storage. Printing or saving a PDF creates your own local copy.

Other services

Google Fonts are loaded through external requests, not through the quiz’s session storage. Those requests disclose network information to Google; see our Privacy notice for details.

Copy buttons use the clipboard only when you choose them. Hosting, email applications, and external websites may have their own storage and logging practices. Server-side request counts and mail handling are explained in our Privacy notice.

Your controls

You can inspect or remove cookies and site data in your browser’s privacy settings. Clearing site data may interrupt an active form session or remove a quiz transfer. Browser settings that block all cookies or session storage can also affect these features.

There are no optional advertising or analytics cookie categories to toggle in the current site. For questions about storage, contact contact@hotwireinteractive.co.uk.
